title: Mounted Stantler changes speed without a position snap

verification.actor: MOUNTED species 234 (Stantler), live bound actor and rider/mount presentation pair
verification.trigger: Prepare the current Stantler mount at Route 29 (585,402), then hold Right until the thirteenth natural Walk starts
verification.observable: All thirteen Right Walks retain exact keyed variance and eased ground motion. The first nominal two-frame Walk retains variance two; its commit reduces the next tile's variance to one, and the next committed normal Walk reduces it to zero. Later Walks remain exactly two frames. Native gait matches the distance/frame reference with bounce2, stride2, settle1 and lean1. Every completed frame and native callback retains one ground anchor while actual sprite XYZ includes the bounded gait and attached rider. The shadow and camera stay ground anchored. Neutral input then permits only two four-frame stop-skid tiles, with one normal world-step callback per skid tile, followed by zero final gait offsets. Copied persistent variance must be rejected.

setupMutations.change: Disposable test.sav; checked teleport to map33 (585,402) facing Right, party0 Stantler and mounted spawn. The clear Right lane was measured in the pre-edit reproduction. No profile/timer changes or source-save writes.

limits: Prepared fixture data does not prove natural mounting, selection or spawning.

This checks one held Right run at authored Sprint chillSpeed 6, walkTimeVariance 2, Mounted maxWalkSpeed 2 and accelerationStep 1. It does not prove other profile values or directions. A one-frame tile remains physically indivisible when another profile permits one.
S4 acceptance needs the current packaged ROM, native mount callback reader, paired completed-frame poses and its independent observer control. Registration alone is not game proof.

events.value: Hold Right through thirteen natural Walk starts

stop.condition: Thirteen Right Walks finish, mounted input releases, and gait settles to zero
